draft:
We cannot give you a typical day, because almost never do we know what an ordinary believer felt through an ordinary week [[lpc.limit.ordinary-interior-life]] [[as:paraphrase]]. We can tell you what was decided about a person, how carefully, and by whom [[lpc.limit.ordinary-interior-life]] [[as:paraphrase]]. Both of our own voices are bishops, so what comes down to us is mostly what a bishop saw and decided [[lpc.limit.ordinary-interior-life]] [[as:paraphrase]].

Some parts of our common life we can still describe. We offered the sacrifice of the Mediator for our dead, and we gave alms in the church on their behalf [[lpc.witness.remembered-at-the-altar]] [[as:paraphrase]]. Augustine taught that these gifts help only those who earned that help in life [[lpc.witness.remembered-at-the-altar]] [[as:paraphrase]]. Augustine's mother, Monica, asked as she lay ill that she be remembered at the Lord's altar [[lpc.witness.remembered-at-the-altar]] [[as:paraphrase]].

We baptized infants, and we would not make a newborn wait [[lpc.witness.infants-and-the-sin-of-another]] [[as:paraphrase]]. In Cyprian's time we took back the failed rather than shutting them out for good [[lpc.gravity.penitential-discipline]] [[as:paraphrase]].
